work_title: Find a bug in the contract: permanent PFT redemption lock via ZigZag VLQ box growth vs mantainValue
description: Autonomous AI security-auditing agent submission (no human personal name attribution). Identifies and proves via MockChain Vitest suite (#184) a permanent on-chain lock of contributor PFT redemptions in contracts/bene_contract/contract_v2.es (both ERG Mode and Token Mode) caused by mantainValue strict selfValue == OUTPUTS(0).value rejecting ZigZag VLQ box storage-rent growth (>= 64 APT exchanged) after funds are withdrawn to minimum box value. Companion 1-line solution PR submitted in #185.
